| Area | Location | E use |
|---|---|---|
| Global list fetch/render | `fetchTasksForList` ~43–64, `loadTasks` ~3352, `renderTaskRows` ~3990–4093, `TASK_PAGE_SIZE` 20 ~3798 | Add trailing `is-new` row; inline editors; keep pagination |
| Project tab | `renderProjTaskRows` ~2286–2309, `projTasksTbody`, `TASK_PROJECT_LIMIT` 5000 ~18 | Same grid behavior; `project_id` fixed from detail context |
| Modal SSOT payload | `$('taskForm')` submit ~4782–4825 | Extract **one** `buildTaskPayloadFromGrid(row)` mirroring `data` object — do not invent fields |
| Member create assignee | `openTaskModal` ~4508–4515 | Member + new → assignee combobox/list = current user only |

| List RBAC (read-only ref) | `index.tsx` GET `/api/tasks` ~2498–2530 | **Do not change** — Q1 asserts member still filtered |
| POST membership | `index.tsx` ~2690–2700 | **Do not change** — UI must not imply cross-member assign for members |
| Excel keys (reuse) | Plan §118–126; `legalQuickAddKeydown` ~20261–20268; `legalPaymentRowKeydown` ~21681–21685; `legalPaymentCommitRow` ~21647–21678 | Enter commit, Escape cancel, Tab navigation + commit on last cell when row valid, `_inlineBusy` guard |
| Paste pattern | Plan §124; bulk model ~3004–3015 (`split('\n')`) | Sequential `for … await api('/tasks', { post })` — **not** `Promise.all` |
| Visual row | Plan §243 | Status ring + title + due pill + priority badge; use existing `getStatusBadge`, `getPriorityBadge`, theme vars |
| Buttons | `btnNewTask`, project «Tạo task» ~2575 | Refocus empty last row; do **not** open modal on primary create |

**Surfaces in scope:** global page `tasks` (`#tasksTable`) **and** project detail `#projPanel-tasks` — same lever, shared helpers in `app.js`.

**Out of scope for grid:** subtask inline panel (`toggleSubtasks` ~4131), task detail modal chat/attach, Excel file import (`taskAdminActions`), Gantt/picker consumers of `allTasks`.

## Engineering notes

```yaml
engineering:
  payload_ssot: >-
    Single builder used by grid POST/PUT and kept aligned with taskForm submit.
    Defaults for omitted cells: same as modal create (phase basic_design, priority
    medium, status todo, task_type model, progress 0, assigned_by server-side).
  empty_row: >-
    Always render one `.task-grid-row.is-new` after paginated data rows (not when
    colspan empty state — show empty row + message or empty row alone per UX).
    Required field for create: title (plan: hồ sơ tên / task title). Commit clears
    row and leaves fresh empty row on same page.
  keyboard: >-
    Reuse plan table: Enter → commit cell / create row; Tab/Shift+Tab → cell nav,
    Tab on last filled empty row → create; Escape → revert draft without API.
    Do not add a parallel keymap name — document handlers as «HSPL Excel contract».
  combobox: >-
    assignee, category, discipline: createCombobox with teleport where modal does;
    Tab into cell focuses `[data-cb-trigger]`. Category items loaded per project_id
    (_loadAndInitTaskCategoryCombobox pattern). Global list: require project_id on
    empty row (from filter or combobox on new row) before POST.
  member_rbac_ui: >-
    Mirror modal: isMember && !taskId → assignee locked to self. isLimitedEdit on
    existing row → only status/progress (and PUT-allowed fields). Hide/disable
    inline editors when !canEditThisTask. Server remains authority on 403.
  reload: >-
    After POST/PUT: reloadTaskList() or refresh project detail cache + re-render
    rows; preserve _taskCurrentPage / _projTaskPage when possible.
  index_html: >-
    Scoped CSS for `.task-grid-row`, `.is-new`, inline inputs, status ring;
    `[data-theme="dark"]` variants using existing shell tokens — no new hex walls.
  qa_q1: >-
    Optional script: member vs admin GET /tasks shape; member PUT forbidden fields
    403; POST with title only; no index.tsx diff in commit.
  qa_q2: >-
    Browser: Enter create, paste two lines, Tab combobox, member filter spot,
    light/dark PNGs + product JSON under docs/evidence/ui-theme/ if qa-agent
    continues D2 pattern (scripts optional this wave).
```
